source.citation: C. Davis and W. M. Kahan, The Rotation of Eigenvectors by a Perturbation. III, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 7(1), 1970, 1–46.
source.note: The checked-in Part III distillation is the distributable source-order semantic audit specification. Its marked passages are independently worded reconstructions that preserve the mathematical hypotheses, conclusions, equations, exceptions, and scope needed for source-to-Lean comparison. No private transcription is required by the static checker or compiler certificate.

completion_rule: The 49 statement-map rows are organizational source/audit groups and the 266 source atoms are a source-fidelity inventory. The 100% formalization denominator is the separate formalization-result inventory: exactly the results Davis--Kahan establish in this paper (the four Section 2 headline theorems plus each named theorem, proposition, lemma, and corollary). Proof equations, derivations, examples, numerical working, historical attributions, Section 10 questions, and claims explicitly left unresolved or deferred are not completion obligations. False printed results are disposed by exact formal refutation and also carry the repository best-effort repair obligation.
